lines.dialogue: Just that everything’s great. Just how I dreamed. Mom, I gotta go.
Yeah. I’m fine.
No thanks.
No, wait. Actually, thank you, I’d... appreciate it.
Just having a bad day, that’s all.
Work thing. You?
You know how you -- you have this image of yourself?

I’m sure that’s not true. I always thought I was... strong, you know? Like, made of steel. A fighter. But then there I was... I needed to fight. Had to. But -- I didn’t. Kept my eyes down, mouth shut, did what it took to keep my job. Turns out I’m not who I thought I was. And I think -- I think I just wanna go home. ANNIE Sorry, I didn’t mean to dump all that on -- HUGHIE No, it’s not that. It’s just, I can relate, I’m -- long story. Listen. Do you like your job? ANNIE It’s the only thing I ever wanted.
Sounds like a smart girl. You should take her advice, too.
Annie.
Will it get through my skin?
Stormfront knows I leaked the V.
Even worse. That means she’s got some fucked up plan for me. I want this chip out, now.
Can we just do this please before I change my mind?
I feel lighter already.
This is where you’re living?
I’m sorry.
Uh. Hi. Remember me...?
No thanks to the 50 caliber round you pumped into my chest.
I broke into her laptop and got a look at her inbox. Dozen messages from Stan Edgar.
How they’re close to a break- through. At the Sage Grove Center? It’s a psychiatric hospital in Pennsylvania.
She came in before I could see any more. MOTHER’S MILK Anyone else on the email?
Someone named ‘Elle?’ MOTHER’S MILK Elle? Who’s she?
I should go in with them.
Here.
Seriously?
What is your problem with me?
That’s why you won’t even touch my hand?
I think it’s exactly the time. I think the time is long overdue. You know I hate Vought as much as you do. But it doesn’t matter.
Cause what you can’t stand is in my blood. I’m sub-human to you. Only good Supe is a dead Supe, right?
You know. Under all that swagger, you’re just a bigot and a bully. I know a guy just like that. He’s got a flag for a cape.
Hughie. You alright? ANNIE (CONT'D) BUTCHER
Oh no oh no.
The kid must’ve fried everything. I gotta draw the power from somewhere. BUTCHER Well, you got a useless fuckin’ superpower, dontcha?
Where? How?
What about the others?
Sir, I need you to step out of your car please.
Butcher, no. Listen, sir --

Whoa, that’s not necessary. Let’s just talk! DENNIS FBI. Get real. You’re not even American! Is he even really hurt? This some scam?? BUTCHER If I wanted to nick some wheels, it wouldn’t be a fuckin’ Hyundai.
Butcher, stop. Buddy, put the gun down!
I said put it down!
He’s dead. You couldn’t just listen to me and stay back??
He’s burning up.
Thanks. Your approval means everything to me.
I know. Know what I was thinking, looking at him? “Why’d you pull a gun, you stupid fuck?” That’s all. Maybe once I would’ve cried for him, but not anymore. Now he was just another person in our way.
No. BUTCHER No what? ANNIE No to that fucking look of quiet respect or approval or whatever it is. I don’t want it. We’re nothing alike. Nothing.
Needs a day or two for the Cefazolin to kick in, but he should be alright.
We’ll have to risk it.
Jesus --
That kids’ shampoo he uses.
And his Axe body spray? It’s how Vin Diesel must smell.
I don’t wanna know that!
But he never quite gives up on you, does he?
He’s too good for either of us.
You’ll be okay. The plan again?
No oversharing with Chili’s waiters. I’m serious about that last one.
I’ll be fine.
Mom --
I don’t... I’m not gonna wear it.
I love you, too.
What’s going on?
What if I testify? MOTHER’S MILK Escaped convicts don’t have a ton of credibility.
Maybe I know someone who does. Just give us the day.
There’s something really important I’ve been meaning to ask you. Last I checked, you’re not 57 years old. So why is it always, always Billy Joel?
No, really. Please?
Butcher’s right, you know. We already tried to bring Vought down the right way. This won’t work. Won’t stop Compound V from getting out there.
Why’d you save me at the Tower?
But you could’ve gotten yourself killed. And after the way I treated you? You had every reason to give up on me -- so why didn’t you?
That’s why I’m helping.
We swiped a tourist’s phone at the Disney Store. They’ll trace it back to the Elsa dolls.
Where’s Elena?
I need to ask you something. It’s a lot. I need you to testify.
On the record. Against Vought, Homelander, Stormfront, everything.
Because things are really bad. And you’re our last chance.
I get that it’s dangerous --
Then what is?
Look. I know it’s easier to just... disappear inside yourself. It’s all I want to do. But we can’t, Maeve, we can’t. This is a war now, and we can’t sit it out, we all gotta pick a side --
Donna gave it to me. Pretty sure she got it at Duane Reade.
Moms. The gift that keeps on giving. Forever.
Shit. Sorry.
No. I’m an asshole for bitching about my mom when yours is...
She’s not? It’s just, you never mentioned her, I thought --
Oh. Wow. I’m really sorry.
Were she and your Dad fighting?
Oh. I’m sure that’s not it --
I don’t know. Going through stuff?
No. It isn’t. At all.
How did you find us?
I’m surprised your heart can take it.
Holy shit. Is this all true?
Hughie!
I know, I know. But if Billy Butcher can do the right thing... then there’s gotta be some kinda higher power, you know?
You too.
No. But if you jump ship and let the assholes steer, guess you’re part of the problem. Someone taught me something about hanging in there?
No, you’re not.
Oh. Right. Okay. No worries. We’ll just be friends then --
Then what do you mean? JANINE Daddy! MOTHER’S MILK Hey, baby girl.
Don’t fucking touch me!
Get out of my head.
Why?
You’re a psychopath.
I don’t think that.
Fuck you. You don’t know anything, about me or my life.
Take Singer! Go, now!
You’re right, I dunno if I’m a hero anymore, I dunno who the fuck I am. But I do know I’m the bitch beating your ass.
I’m fine.
“Find Your Phone.” I also found your fucking fiancé.
No? You put the ring on her finger! I know, cause I pried it off her dead fucking hand!
So you did fuck her.
How many times?
I was gone for like ten days!

Yeah, and as long as you were getting laid, you didn’t look too close. That’s the Annie you want, right? Down to go down whenever. The perfect girl, and a piece of ass in the bargain, who doesn’t get depressed or fucked up or come with any complications.
You’ve got to be kidding me.
It’s insane we’re discussing this!
Really. Just -- fuck it? MOTHER’S MILK We’re probably dead either way, so might as well go out with our heads high. Fuck it.
Oh. Great. MOTHER’S MILK Annie. It was crazy to give A-Train a chance, look what happened.
Shit. Fuck it.
Shut up. You are going to get tested for every disease known to man. I am not getting Shifter syphilis.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: A lot more than one.
